facts.fact: The eAqoonsi app, linked to the national identification system, is in use: users verify their account with a one-time password and access a digital ID, per NIRA and Hiiraan Online.
A Mogadishu user said she obtained a valid digital ID at home through the eAqoonsi app without revisiting a NIRA center; Google Play shows over 50,000 downloads.

SOM.note: No civil register link is stated.

facts.fact: Nearly two million people had registered for the national ID by April 2026 against a target of 15 million IDs by 2029, per Hiiraan Online; about 10% of the 19.7 million population (computed from the population given).

SOM.note: Registration is in person at NIRA centers; no number at birth is stated.
Who builds or maintains the system is not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: NIRA registers people at its centers and gives them an 11-digit national ID number, with nearly two million registered, per NIRA's director and Hiiraan Online.
